description: Awarding the Contract for Ground Handling Services and Cargo Warehouse Handling Services for SriLankan Airlines Limited at the Shanghai Airport, China
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- The International Air Transportation Association has published a Standard Ground Handling Agreement specifying the services required to be performed by a Ground Handling Service Provider for an airline, and Ground Handling Services mainly consist of passenger, ramp and cargo warehouse handling services. The contract for the provision of Passenger and Ramp Handling Services and the contract for the provision of Cargo Warehouse Handling Services for SriLankan Airlines Limited at Shanghai Airport, China are scheduled to expire on 2025-12-31 and on 2026-03-31 respectively. Bids have been invited from the licensed vendors operating at the said Airport following the limited international competitive bidding procedure for the provision of the above services. Accordingly, the following proposals made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation based on the recommendations of the Standing High Level Procurement Committee, were approved by the Cabinet:

To award the contract for the provision of Passenger and Ramp Handling Services for a period of 03 years from 2026‑01‑01 to 2028‑12‑31 to China Eastern Airlines Co. Ltd., the substantially responsive sole bidder, at an estimated cost of CNY 27.929 million.
To award the contract for the provision of Cargo Warehouse Handling Services for a period of 03 years from 2026‑04‑01 to 2029‑03‑31 to China Eastern Air Logistics Co. Ltd, the substantially responsive sole bidder, at an estimated cost of CNY 5.167 million
